**Schaffalitzky de Muckadell OB** refers to Ole Byriel Schaffalitzky de Muckadell, Professor Emeritus in Gastroenterology at the University of Copenhagen. He should not be confused with other individuals bearing similar names. 

He is a recognized gastroenterologist and senior researcher who has contributed significantly to the evidence base for acute surgery [^src1]. His work is highlighted in the 2024 Annual Report for the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB), published by the Danish Healthcare Quality Programme (RKKP), which presents quality measurement results for acute surgery in Denmark [^src1]. Specifically, his name appears in six scientific references on page 96 of the report, underscoring his active role in clinical quality development and research utilizing the database's data [^src1]. 

Among his notable contributions documented in the report is his collaborative research with [[laursen-sb|Laursen SB]]. Together, they co-authored a study investigating the use of Selective Serotonin Receptor Inhibitors (SSRIs), concluding that their use is not associated with an increased risk of endoscopy-refractory bleeding, rebleeding, or mortality in peptic ulcer bleeding [^src1]. The inclusion of his scientific activity in the annual report validates the AKDB's role as a central tool for clinical research and systematic quality improvement across Danish regions [^src1].
